SUMMARY
Senior Software Senior Java Developer with 9+ years of experience in Java (8/11/17/21), Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven architecture. Expertise in Kafka, Axon Framework, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Skilled in with hands-on experience in cloud platforms (PCF, AWS), API security, and performance optimization.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
MASTERCARD	Pune, India
Senior Software Engineer	12/2019 – Present
Global technology company in the payments industry
Led the design and development of scalable, secure, and high-performance Java (Spring Boot) applications for payment processing systems.
Developed Axon-Kafka-based event-driven microservices implementing CQRS and Event Sourcing, enabling real-time data processing and persistence.
Integrated CaaS (Crypto as a Service) for encryption and decryption operations in
the MADA Modernization, leveraging JWE/JWS standards. Utilized environment-specific certificates (private-public key pairs) across PCF Dev, Stage, and ITF environments to ensure secure communication and compliance with Mastercard's cryptographic policies.
Developed an AI-powered code review system integrated with Bitbucket APIs, triggered via webhooks to analyze pull requests using a custom ML model. Automatically generated inline comments for code quality and performance.
Migrate the MADA Acquirer target application to PCF improving scalability by 40%. refactoring legacy components and externalizing configurations to enable cloud-native deployment with improved scalability, reliability, and CI/CD automation.
Reduced time-to-market by 20% through Agile practices
Collaborated with Product Owners and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver business-critical features.
Led sprint planning, task estimation, and delivery tracking using JIRA and Confluence.
Integrated CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Git, and SonarQube for automated testing and deployment.
Mentored junior developers, conducted technical workshops, and facilitated peer programming sessions.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
HCL	Pune, India
Senior Software Engineer	05/2019 – 11/2019
Global technology company
Delivered high-quality code for Mastercard Payment Gateway Services under Agile methodology.
Ensured timely delivery of features aligned with client expectations and quality benchmarks.
TCS	Pune, India
System Engineer	03/2016 – 04/2019
Global leader in IT services and consulting
Worked with Morgan Stanley as a client, contributing to the development and enhancement of modules for vendor and ERP applications.
Built robust and maintainable enterprise solutions using Java, JSP, Servlets, and J2EE design patterns, while developing dynamic user interfaces with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to enhance usability and performance.
